# Open-access PDF recordings

`arxiv-2109.00022.pdf` is the arXiv PDF of S. Leuchtner, C. M. Nicolás and
A. Suk, "A Note on Visible Islands", arXiv:2109.00022v3 (14 Feb 2022),
published as Studia Sci. Math. Hungarica 59(2) 160-163,
doi:10.1556/012.2022.01524. It is distributed under the Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) and is
kept here unmodified, as https://arxiv.org/pdf/2109.00022 served it on
2026-11-25. Pass 3 tests check quotations against its extracted text.

A cassette names a binary body with `responseFile`, a file in the same folder,
because a PDF does not survive being stored as JSON text.

`synthetic-oa-lookups.json` holds made-up OpenAlex, Unpaywall and publisher
answers under the 10.0000 test prefix, for the cases no real record shows
reliably: a work with no open-access PDF, and an open-access link that serves
a login page instead of a PDF.
